scope: web-chat user accounts accessed programmatically through OpenCode WebBridge, not API or open-weight local models

providers.finding: European consumer terms prohibit automatic or programmatic extraction of output; no separate WebBridge authorization is established.
Section 3.5 limits capturing or copying service content with robots, spiders or other automated setups; no written exemption confirmed.
Google terms restrict automated access that violates machine-readable instructions; no independently verified permission for a Gemini web chat relay.
Terms prohibit automated interaction or extraction of information and outputs, and scraping or distillation; no authorized exception verified.
Le Chat-specific terms restrict integration/combination with other software without prior written authorization. Current EU terms must also be independently rechecked.
